lines.text: Meta's AI agent, Muse, can now talk with you out loud, in real time, with an animated face.
On November 5th, Meta started rolling out live voice chats and expressive avatars in the Muse app, in the US, on mobile, web and Mac.
Tap the phone icon, then pick voice only, an avatar beside the chat, or a full-screen avatar.
You can cut in mid-answer, and Muse can keep working on tasks in the background while you talk.
The faces come from a Meta Superintelligence Labs model, Muse Realtime Avatar. It reads the same speech tokens as the voice, so lips and expressions stay in sync.
Meta says its own raters preferred these avatars over rivals like Runway and HeyGen. Remember, that's Meta's own test.
Voice is also coming to Meta's AI glasses and Muse Charm, but there's no date yet. Would you talk to an AI face?
